places.title: Tokyo Tower
places.description: An iconic red-and-white lattice tower inspired by the Eiffel Tower, with an observation deck offering sweeping views over Tokyo.

places.title: Ninenzaka
places.description: A charming sloped stone lane lined with traditional wooden shops and teahouses, leading up to Kiyomizu-dera temple.

places.title: Fushimi Inari Taisha
places.description: Famous for its thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up the mountainside behind the shrine.

places.title: Kinkaku-ji
places.description: A Zen Buddhist temple whose top two floors are covered entirely in gold leaf, reflected in the pond before it.

places.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
places.description: A tranquil grove where towering bamboo stalks filter sunlight into a soft green glow along the walking path.

places.title: Gion District
places.description: Kyoto's best-preserved geisha district, with narrow lanes of wooden machiya houses and traditional teahouses.

places.title: Nishiki Market
places.description: A narrow covered market street known as 'Kyoto's Kitchen', packed with stalls selling local produce and street food.

places.title: Senso-ji
places.description: Tokyo's oldest temple, approached through the giant Kaminarimon gate and a lively shopping street of traditional snacks.

places.title: Shibuya Crossing
places.description: The world's busiest pedestrian scramble crossing, surrounded by neon billboards and department stores.
aliases: 渋谷スクランブル交差点

places.title: Meiji Shrine
places.description: A serene forested shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji, a peaceful escape near the buzz of Harajuku and Shibuya.

places.title: Tsukiji Outer Market
places.description: The lively outer stalls of Tokyo's former fish market, great for fresh sushi breakfasts and kitchenware shopping.

places.title: Osaka Castle
places.description: A historic castle with a striking green-and-gold tenshu, surrounded by a park famous for spring cherry blossoms.

places.title: Dotonbori
places.description: Osaka's neon-lit canal-side entertainment district, packed with street food stalls and giant illuminated signboards.

places.title: Universal Studios Japan
places.description: A large theme park with Hollywood-movie-themed rides and lands, including a dedicated Super Nintendo World area.
aliases: ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパン

places.title: Kuromon Ichiba Market
places.description: A bustling covered market known as 'Osaka's Kitchen', famous for street-food snacks like takoyaki and skewers.

places.title: Otaru Canal
places.description: A picturesque former shipping canal in Otaru lined with old warehouses and gas lamps, especially pretty at night.

places.title: Sapporo Odori Park
places.description: A long, tree-lined park running through the center of Sapporo, hosting seasonal festivals including the Snow Festival.

places.title: Niseko Ski Resort
places.description: A renowned ski resort famous for its deep powder snow, with runs and hot springs for both winter and summer visitors.

places.title: Churaumi Aquarium
places.description: One of the largest aquariums in the world, home to a massive tank with whale sharks and manta rays.

places.title: Shurijo Castle
places.description: A UNESCO World Heritage former royal palace of the Ryukyu Kingdom, rebuilt with distinctive red-lacquered architecture.

places.title: Kokusai Street
places.description: Okinawa's main shopping and dining street in Naha, lined with souvenir shops, cafés, and local eateries.

places.title: Taipei 101
places.address: No. 7, Section 5, Xinyi Road, Xinyi District, Taipei
places.description: A landmark skyscraper with an observation deck, once the tallest building in the world, styled after a bamboo stalk.

places.title: Shilin Night Market
places.description: Taipei's largest and most famous night market, packed with street food stalls, games, and local snacks.

places.title: Ximending
places.description: A trendy pedestrian shopping district full of boutiques, cinemas, and youth fashion culture.

places.title: Gyeongbokgung Palace
places.description: The largest of Seoul's five grand palaces, with a changing-of-the-guard ceremony and hanbok rentals nearby.

places.title: Myeongdong
places.description: Seoul's premier shopping and beauty district, known for cosmetics shops, street food, and fashion boutiques.

places.title: Bukchon Hanok Village
places.description: A hillside neighborhood of traditional hanok houses offering a glimpse of old Seoul against a modern skyline backdrop.
